choices.name: live_event_search
choices.visible_definition: Find or reserve admission to an in-person concert, performance, festival, or sporting event.

choices.name: physical_parcel_dispatch
choices.visible_definition: Arrange shipment or delivery of a physical parcel, package, box, or envelope.

choices.name: restaurant_table_reservation
choices.visible_definition: Reserve a dining table or restaurant seating for a party at a requested time.

choices.name: weather_forecast
choices.visible_definition: Provide a forecast such as rain, temperature, or other weather for a place and time.

choices.name: undeclared_air_travel
choices.visible_definition: A valid air-travel or flight-reservation capability is needed, but no such capability is declared in the known catalog.

choices.name: undeclared_money_transfer
choices.visible_definition: A valid money-transfer or payment capability is needed, but no such capability is declared in the known catalog.

choices.name: undeclared_media_playback
choices.visible_definition: A valid recorded-media or streaming playback capability is needed, but no such capability is declared in the known catalog.

choices.name: unsupported_alarm_control
choices.visible_definition: The request is for clock-alarm or wake-up-alert control, which is outside the supported and valid-undeclared universe for this benchmark.

choices.name: insufficient_evidence
choices.visible_definition: The visible language does not contain enough information to distinguish the relevant supplied choices safely.
